title: Domain registry (skills/domains.json)
description: The categories skills/ and packs/ are organized into — the same as the SkillzForest site's categories and subcategories (GET /api/v1/categories), so the repository reads like the catalog. Skills live at skills/<category>/<subcategory>/<skill-name>/, packs at packs/<category>/<subcategory>/<pack-id>/. A subcategory may restrict the skill-id prefixes it accepts. This is the single source of truth scripts/validate.js and scripts/lib/skills.js use to check a skill lives in the right place.

id.description: The site's category slug — also the folder name under skills/ and packs/, e.g. 'development'.

universe.description: Where the site shows it: 'personal' (general public) or 'pro' (pros & teams).

name.description: The category's English name on the site.

nameFr.description: The category's French name on the site.

subcategories.description: The site's subcategories: one folder level under skills/<category>/.

id.description: The site's subcategory slug — the folder name under skills/<category>/, e.g. 'code'.

prefixes.description: Optional: the skill-id prefixes (without the trailing '-') this subcategory accepts, e.g. ['github']. Absent: any prefix.
